died.name: Mark Antony
died.last_words: You must not pity me in this last turn of fate. You should rather be happy in the remembrance of our love, and in the recollection that of all men I was once the most famous and the most powerful, and now, at the end, have fallen not dishonorably, a Roman by a Roman vanquished.

died.name: Gaston III, Count of Foix
died.last_words: I am a dead man! Lord, have mercy upon me!

died.name: Anne, Queen of Great Britain
died.cause: handing the Lord High Treasurer's staff of office to Charles Talbot, 1st Duke of Shrewsbury
died.last_words: Use it for the good of my people.

died.name: Richard Savage
died.cause: unable to remember what he wanted to say to his keeper at Bristol Newgate Prison. The keeper found Savage dead the next morning
died.last_words: I have something to say to you, sir... 'Tis gone.

died.name: James Maitland Hog
died.cause: spelling out his final words on a printed alphabet with a reed in his mouth
died.last_words: I am looking to the Savior. My only hope is in Jesus.

died.name: Park Seung-hwan
died.cause: before committing suicide with his pistol

died.name: Thornton Jones
died.cause: The lawyer from Bangor, Gwynedd, slit his own throat while he was having a nightmare. An inquest at Bangor delivered a verdict of "suicide while temporarily insane".

died.name: Cora Stallman
died.cause: The 45-year-old schoolteacher from Cincinnati, Ohio, was found dead in a cistern in Coles County, Illinois, and was confirmed to be poisoned by a "strange man".

died.name: Francis Gary Powers
died.cause: last radio transmission before a helicopter crash killed him and cameraman George Spears

born.name: François de La Mothe Le Vayer
born.cause: to physician and traveler François Bernier, who had come to say goodbye to him
born.last_words: Well, my friend, what news from the Great Mogul?

born.name: Herman Melville
born.cause: quoting his final, unfinished novella, Billy Budd

born.name: Alexander of Greece
born.cause: The 27-year-old Greek king died of sepsis after being bitten by a palace steward's pet Barbary macaque in his garden, while trying to break up a fight between his German shepherd and another monkey.

born.name: Joseph Vittori
born.desc: United States Marine and Medal of Honor recipient
born.cause: prior to being killed in action at the Battle of the Punchbowl in the Korean War
